name: IndependentAmount
description: A class specifying the Independent Amount as the combination of a payer/receiver, a payment amount, a payment date and an associated payment calculation rule.

payerAccountReference.description: A reference to the account responsible for making the payments defined by this structure.

payerPartyReference.description: The party responsible for making the payments defined by this structure.

paymentDetail.description: An attribute that specifies a payment as the combination of a payment amount, a payment date and an associated payment calculation rule.

receiverAccountReference.description: A reference to the account that receives the payments corresponding to this structure.

receiverPartyReference.description: The party that receives the payments corresponding to this structure.
